Definition: from G4253 and G2372; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity:--ready, willing.
BiblicalUsage: Prothymos means ready, willing, forward in spirit. Jesus said in Gethsemane, The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. And Paul says, So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the willing spirit is the truest thing about me and the weakest: it wants to watch and pray, and the flesh falls asleep. I hold that Paul's readiness is the answer, because readiness does not wait for strength, it offers what it has.
